thread:
jamie: Quick check — PR #11321 (big cache refactor) is green locally but CI shows 2 flaky tests. I'm hoping to land before the deploy freeze next Mon. Need final +2 and a rebase window. What do folks think?

sanjay: I kicked a full rerun, deploy-bot shows jobs queued. The flaky failures are in integration:auth and e2e/session-timeout.

deploy-bot: CI status for PR 11321: queued -> running -> 2/12 failed (integration:auth, e2e/session-timeout). Rerun: triggered by @sanjay.

marta: Freeze starts Mon 2024-12-16 09:00 UTC. If landing is not urgent, we should avoid last-minute changes. Can we get a canary in Dedicated on Tue? Otherwise plan a rebase window Tue 06:00-08:00 UTC.

olivia: Thanks — I'm the author. The change is mostly storage layer and needed for perf work next sprint. I'm comfortable holding to Tue canary if CI keeps failing. If we need to land early, I can do a focused rebase but will need 2 approvals and a green CI.

jamie: @kevin @sanjay can you do a quick review? main risks are the sharded cache migration and migration script ordering. Also, if we rebase, prefer to do it during the 06:00-08:00 window marta suggested.

kevin: I'll take a look in the morning. If tests still flake, we should isolate integration:auth and run it locally with `./scripts/test integration:auth --repeat 50` to reproduce.

sanjay: FYI we had a transient infra issue earlier today that made e2e timeouts unstable. I'll watch the rerun and can pin the test environment if needed.

olivia: quick note — rebase steps I'm planning:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout feature/cache-refactor
git rebase origin/main
# resolve conflicts in migration.sql (prefer newer ordering)
git push --force-with-lease
```
If someone could hold an eye during the push that would be great.

marta: If you do force-push during the rebase window, ping #eng-oncall too. We don't want to trample any in-flight deploys. Also include a short rollback plan in the PR description.

jamie: Ack. Olivia, add a one-liner rollback (revert migration) and I'll +2 after kevin's review if CI is green.

olivia: Will do. Adding rollback note and triggering `./scripts/ci/rerun-failed --pr 11321` now.

deploy-bot: Rerun triggered by @olivia. Current status: running -> 12/12 passed.

kevin: LGTM. Small nits inline but nothing blocking. +1 from me.

jamie: Giving +1 as well, but hold merge until we confirm no deploys in flight. @marta any objections to landing now that CI is green?

marta: No objections. Landing is fine; please land in the next 30 minutes to avoid the freeze window risk. I'll notify oncall.

olivia: Landing now. Pushing.

deploy-bot: Merge executed: PR 11321 merged by olivia. Release pipeline started.

jamie: Thanks all :tada: If anything weird shows up in canary, we'll roll back immediately.

marta: Thanks. Adding note to release tracker about the migration ordering.
